lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Solve □ ÷ 7 = 6 and check.

FEEDBACK
□ = 42; check 42 ÷ 7 = 6.

WATCH FOR
Skipping the check leaves inverse errors hidden.

INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Complete a twenty-item missing-number fluency set. Substitution-check all twenty.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

lesson.parent_notes:
Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: Complete a twenty-item missing-number fluency set. Substitution-check all twenty. Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Original response on new material: □ = 42; check 42 ÷ 7 = 6. Reasoning: I used fluency by attending to missing number rather than copying the worked model.

Parent: Written model 2: Common error: Skipping the check leaves inverse errors hidden. Correction: □ = 42; check 42 ÷ 7 = 6. Why: the correction restores accurate use of fluency.

Parent: Likely misconception: Skipping the check leaves inverse errors hidden. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Solve one fresh problem that uses fluency with different numbers from the worked model. Show working and name the places or values that matter.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Describe one likely mistake with fluency, show corrected working, and say why the correction works.

WORKED MODEL

TRY FIRST

teach_steps.explain:
Missing-number fluency mixes symbols, inverses and quick checks across addition, subtraction, multiplication and division sentences.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
